relations: The conical mound rests centered within the shallow liquid pool on the plate, maintaining its footprint.
A vertical plant-stem shadow crosses the liquid beneath the mound, persisting as the light shifts subtly.
A bright highlight near the mound's lower edge varies in intensity with the cool bluish illumination.
The granular surface shows only minor texture changes while the surrounding clear liquid remains still.
caption: The video captures a close view of a ceramic plate with a dark outer rim and pale interior, resting on a dark textured surface under cool bluish light. At the center of the plate sits a small conical mound of white granular material, ringed by a shallow, irregular pool of clear liquid. A thin plant-stem shadow runs vertically across the liquid below the mound. The plate, pool outline, and mound remain near their positions throughout, with the mound’s overall height and footprint largely unchanged. A small bright highlight or bubble is visible near the lower edge of the mound, and its brightness varies slightly with the light. The granular surface shows only minor apparent texture changes, without clear visible spreading, flow, or movement of the surrounding pool. The close framing is largely steady, with no obvious change in scale, and subtle brightness shifts mark the mostly static composition. The mound’s pale surface carries fine dark specks, and the surrounding liquid remains clear.
